title: SHSU vs UNT: tuition, size, accreditation
summary: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) versus University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT). Also searched as UNT vs SHSU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and the University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) are both public institutions but differ significantly in size and location. SHSU, located in Huntsville, has an undergraduate enrollment of 17,743 students, whereas UNT in Fort Worth enrolls only 41 undergraduates. Additionally, SHSU charges an in-state tuition of $9,228, while UNT does not provide in-state tuition data. These differences highlight the contrast between SHSU's larger, more traditional university setting and UNT's specialized health science focus.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance, Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and the University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) show notable differences. SHSU charges an in-state tuition of $9,228 and an out-of-state tuition of $19,068. In contrast, UNT does not provide specific tuition figures for either in-state or out-of-state students. Additionally, the median debt for students completing their programs at SHSU is $21,983, while UNT does not report median debt data. These figures reflect SHSU's more traditional tuition structure compared to UNT's specialized health science programs.

sections.heading: Learning model and campus
paragraphs: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and the University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) differ notably in their learning models and campus environments. SHSU, located in Huntsville, Texas, serves a large undergraduate population of 17,743 students, reflecting a comprehensive university setting with diverse academic offerings. In contrast, UNT, situated in Fort Worth, Texas, has a much smaller undergraduate enrollment of 41 students, indicative of its specialized focus on health science education. These distinctions underscore SHSU's role as a broad-based institution compared to UNT's concentrated health science mission.

sections.heading: Accreditation
paragraphs: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and the University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) are both accredited public institutions, ensuring they meet established standards of quality in higher education. sections.heading: Pick SHSU if
